statement: The first line holds R and C. The next R lines each hold a string of C digits: 0 empty, 1 fresh orange, 2 rotten orange. Every minute, each rotten orange rots the fresh oranges sharing a side with it. Print the number of minutes until no fresh orange remains, or -1 if some fresh orange can never rot. Run a multi-source BFS: seed the queue with every rotten cell at minute 0, expand ring by ring, and count fresh cells as they rot - any survivor at the end means -1.

example.why: The rot snakes through the connected fresh cells; the farthest one sits four rings from the source.

hint: All sources enter the queue before the loop starts - that is what makes the spread simultaneous.
mistake: Running a separate BFS per rotten orange and merging per-cell minimums; one seeded queue does it in a single pass.
